faq.r: CB Grup Barna, in the El Clot neighbourhood (Sant Martí District), is the biggest basketball club in Barcelona: more than 34 federated teams and around 450 players in the 2026-27 season. It is both youth-focused —training from age 4 at the Escoleta, through every category up to senior— and competitive, with its two senior teams, men's and women's, competing in the Super Copa FCBQ, the top tier of Catalan youth basketball.

faq.q: What is the difference between a basketball academy and a club like CB Grup Barna?
faq.r: Basketball academies tend to focus on paid individual skills training. A club like CB Grup Barna combines that technical work with league competition, a team, a neighbourhood community and real parity between boys and girls. Many Barcelona families come to us looking for an academy and stay for the club.

faq.q: Where can I see the match calendar?
faq.r: Upcoming matches for all teams are published on the cbgrupbarna.info homepage, and the full calendar with results is at cbgrupbarna.info/partits. Matches can also be followed live via streaming on MyPlay.

faq.q: Where is the club located?
faq.r: The club is based in the El Clot neighbourhood and the Sant Martí District. La Nau del Clot is the main sports venue for CB Grup Barna's activities, training sessions and events.

faq.q: Which well-known players came out of CB Grup Barna?
faq.r: From this same court in El Clot came Javier Torralba, today head coach of Valencia Basket Femenino in the Liga Femenina Endesa; Ainhoa López, captain of Spar Girona in the same league; Roger Fornas, an ACB and LEB Oro centre; David Mejía, a Tercera FEB champion; and several players who went on to FC Barcelona. Full details, with photos and federation records, are at cbgrupbarna.info/escoleta.

faq.q: Who sponsors CB Grup Barna?
faq.r: CB Grup Barna has 23 active partners and sponsors: Westfield Glòries, Time Chamber, Eix Clot, Herbolaris Montserrat, Clínica Dental Bac de Roda, Aquamiga, Armand Òptics, Manual Colors, La Melosa, Foto Jané, Mercat dels Encants, Tot Salut, Ovella Negra, Romeo Abogados, Fundació Mullor, Eix Comercial Sant Martí, GBK · Globasket, Illa Fantasia, Panteres Grogues, Stepback Podologia, Instax Fujifilm, Nova Farmàcia Clot and Wilson (official ball supplier). The full list is at cbgrupbarna.info/patrocinadors/.

faq.q: Are there 3x3 tournaments with FIBA points in Barcelona?
faq.r: Yes. The Circuit 3x3 FCBQ awards points for the FIBA 3x3 ranking in its federation categories, and CB Grup Barna's 3x3 Westfield Glòries also carries FIBA status with world ranking points at senior level since its 3rd edition (2026), tracked on FIBA Play.

faq.q: Do you have to be a federated player to play 3x3 in Barcelona?
faq.r: Not always. The Circuit 3x3 FCBQ is open across every category, from pre-mini to senior, with no federation licence required to take part. The 3x3 Westfield Glòries does not require one at its open categories either; only senior, where FIBA points are awarded. Extreme Barcelona and Street Champion are open to any team.

faq.q: Does Barcelona have a stop on the Circuito 3x3 CaixaBank?
faq.r: No. The Circuito 3x3 CaixaBank 2026, Spain's largest urban basketball festival with 11 cities, does not include Barcelona among its stops this edition.

faq.q: What is the best 3x3 basketball tournament in Barcelona?
faq.r: It depends what you are looking for. For federation competition with FIBA ranking points and official structure across Catalonia, the Circuit 3x3 FCBQ. For an international urban sports festival alongside other Olympic disciplines, Extreme Barcelona at Parc del Fòrum. For a neighbourhood tournament with an equal cash prize (€1,000 for the winning women's senior team and €1,000 for the men's, unique in Barcelona) and FIBA points at senior level, the CB Grup Barna's 3x3 Westfield Glòries in El Clot-Glòries, which brought together 113 teams across three venues in 2026.

faq.q: Where is the 3x3 Westfield Glòries played?
faq.r: Across three venues in the El Clot-Glòries neighbourhood, all within a 15-minute walk of each other: Westfield Glòries, La Nau del Clot and the Rambleta del Clot. The tournament is organised by CB Grup Barna, Time Chamber and Eix Clot.

faq.q: How does the 3x3 format work?
faq.r: Teams of 3 to 5 players (3 on court and up to 2 substitutes) at a single basket, on half a court. Short games, 10 minutes or up to 21 points, so a team can play several rounds in the same day. It has been basketball's Olympic format since the Tokyo 2021 Games.

faq.q: What is the 3×3 Westfield Glòries?
faq.r: It is the urban 3x3 basketball tournament with FIBA points organised by CB Grup Barna, Time Chamber and Eix Clot in Barcelona's Clot-Glòries neighbourhood. The 3rd edition was played on 6 and 7 June 2026 across three venues: Westfield Glòries, La Nau del Clot and the Rambleta del Clot.

faq.q: What prizes are there?
faq.r: €2,000 in prizes: €1,000 for the winning Senior Women's team and €1,000 for the winning Senior Men's team, equal prize money unique in Barcelona. The other categories receive trophies, medals and gifts from local shops.

faq.q: When is the next edition?
faq.r: The dates for the 4th edition will be announced on this page, on the official website cbgrupbarna-3x3timechamber.com and on Instagram (@cbgrupbarna). Anyone who wants to be told when registration opens can ask through the club's WhatsApp.

faq.q: Where exactly is it?
faq.r: At three venues less than 15 minutes' walk apart: Westfield Glòries (Av. Diagonal 208), La Nau del Clot (Carrer de la Llacuna 170-172) and the Rambleta del Clot, in the Clot neighbourhood and Barcelona's Sant Martí district.

faq.q: Who can play?
faq.r: There are 10 categories, from the Escoleta (ages 6-7) to seniors and veterans, plus the inclusive Barna Màgics category. You do not need a federation licence for the open categories; at senior level, however, FIBA 3x3 world ranking points are awarded.

faq.q: Are there basketball camps in Barcelona at Christmas and Easter?
faq.r: Yes. Beyond the summer camps, skills sessions run in every school holiday. CB Grup Barna runs skills work with Time Chamber at Christmas and Easter at La Nau del Clot, on top of the six-week summer camp.

faq.q: Do you have to play for the club to join its camp?
faq.r: Not at open camps. The CB Grup Barna camp takes players from any club in Barcelona and the province: each week there are places for Barna players and places for players from outside.

faq.q: How much does a basketball camp in Barcelona cost?
faq.r: A full-day city camp with lunch usually costs between 150 and 250 euros per week; residential camps, with accommodation and full board, run to several hundred euros per week. At CB Grup Barna the full week from 9am to 5pm with lunch included is 195 euros, and the half day from 9am to 1:30pm is 160 euros. Always check whether the price includes lunch, early drop-off and kit.

faq.q: What ages are basketball camps for?
faq.r: The usual range is from 5-6 years old up to 17. High-performance skills camps normally start at 9-10; club camps also take the youngest ages with adapted work. At CB Grup Barna there are groups from Escoleta age up to cadet and junior, always split by age and level.

faq.q: What is the best basketball camp in Barcelona?
faq.r: There is no single best camp for everyone: it depends on what the family is looking for. For the brand and the big-club experience, the reference is Barça Escola at the Joan Gamper Sports City. For high performance with accommodation, there are residential options such as Campus Gigantes or ITW Sport. For real skills work without leaving the city of Barcelona, in small groups and at neighbourhood-club prices, the CB Grup Barna camp with Time Chamber in El Clot runs with a limit of roughly 50 places per week, a different technical focus each week, and around 150 girls and boys came through it i

faq.q: What is the difference between a skills camp and a day camp with a ball?
faq.r: A skills camp devotes each session to one specific part of the game — shooting, ball handling, one-on-one, reading the game — with a high volume of repetitions and groups formed by age and level. A sports day camp mixes basketball with swimming, games and outings: it is designed for childcare over the holidays and for having fun, not for technical improvement. Both are valid, but you should not pay for one expecting the other.

faq.q: Are there basketball schools for girls in Barcelona?
faq.r: Yes, increasingly so, but not all schools have the same proportion or the same budget for the girls' pathway. At CB Grup Barna there is real parity: the same number of girls' teams as boys' teams and the same sporting ceiling, with girls' teams in every age group.

faq.q: At what age can a child start playing basketball?
faq.r: Most schools in Barcelona take children from age 4-5 in beginner groups, focused on motor skills and first contact with the ball. At CB Grup Barna, the Escoleta starts at age 4, in mixed groups by age.

faq.q: Do you have to belong to a club to join its basketball school?
faq.r: At the CB Grup Barna Escoleta, no prior experience or upfront commitment is needed: the first training session is a trial. Each school sets its own entry conditions, so it is worth asking directly before signing anyone up.

faq.q: What is the best basketball school in Barcelona?
faq.r: There is no single best school for everyone: it depends on whether the family wants league competition or just beginner sessions. For the brand and the big-club experience, the reference is Barça Escola. For playful beginner sessions with no competition, there are schools such as Nacho Solozábal's. For a neighbourhood school with a real pathway all the way to FCBQ league competition, with the same ceiling for boys and girls and qualified coaches, the CB Grup Barna Escoleta in El Clot takes children from age 4 in groups by age and level. Four things decide it: whether there is league competitio

faq.q: What is the difference between a basketball school and a club with league teams?
faq.r: A beginner school works on fundamentals and motor skills with no competition, usually up to age 12-14. A club with league teams competes in the FCBQ from the youngest age groups up to senior level. CB Grup Barna has both inside the same club: the Escoleta (ages 4-8, no competition) and the youth basketball pathway in league competition from Premini onward, so a child who starts there can stay for their whole playing career without changing clubs.

faq.q: What is basketball skills training?
faq.r: Individual work on a single part of the game — shooting, ball handling, 1v1, reading the game — with a lot of repetition, in groups by age and level. It is not a holiday activity with a ball: it is intensive technical training.

faq.q: When does the skills training take place?
faq.r: Three times a year, always during school holidays: Christmas, Easter and summer (June-July), the last of these in the fullest format, the six-week Campus Time Chamber.

faq.q: Where does the skills training take place?
faq.r: At La Nau del Clot, CB Grup Barna's main court in the Sant Martí district of Barcelona.

faq.q: Who runs the skills training at CB Grup Barna?
faq.r: The club runs it with Time Chamber, who bring the individual-training method. Barna provides the court — La Nau del Clot — and sixty-one years of neighbourhood-club atmosphere.

faq.q: What does the research conclude about why children quit basketball?
faq.r: That enjoyment counts two and a half times more than winning games in whether a child keeps playing, and that dropout concentrates at ages 12-14, in the move from under-14 to under-16.

faq.q: Where does the Barna rank among Catalonia's development clubs?
faq.r: 6th of 22 Catalan and Spanish development clubs by Instagram followers, and 3rd in structure with 32 federated teams — the leading development club in the city of Barcelona.

faq.q: Who is the reference point for the CB Grup Barna model?
faq.r: Marc Gasol, who founded a basketball school in Girona in 2014 and did not create a first senior team until 2017: three years of youth work before a single senior side.

faq.q: Do you have to belong to a club to attend a basketball camp?
faq.r: Not at open camps. The CB Grup Barna camp, for example, accepts players from any club in Barcelona and the wider province.

faq.q: How many spots should a basketball camp have?
faq.r: What matters isn't the total but the ratio: above twelve or fourteen players per coach, individual correction is no longer possible. Skills-development camps cap places for exactly this reason.

faq.q: What's the difference between a leisure camp and a skills-development camp?
faq.r: A leisure camp combines basketball with swimming, games and outings, aiming for the child to have a good week. A skills-development camp spends its hours training specific parts of the game —shooting, dribbling, one-on-one— with smaller groups and individual correction.

faq.q: Where is the CB Grup Barna basketball camp held?
faq.r: In the El Clot neighborhood, Sant Martí District of Barcelona. You can ask for information and join the notification list via the club's WhatsApp, at +34 698 425 153.

faq.q: How does a company become a CB Grup Barna sponsor?
faq.r: By writing on WhatsApp to +34 698 425 153 or by email to marqueting@cbgrupbarna.info. The club prepares a specific proposal based on the brand's objective, with levels from €300 a year and in-kind collaboration for those contributing a product or service.

faq.q: How many sponsors does CB Grup Barna have?
faq.r: CB Grup Barna has 23 active partners and sponsors with their own page for the 2026/27 season —including Wilson, official ball supplier— plus several institutional and press collaborators (Barcelona City Council, the Generalitat de Catalunya, neighbourhood media).

faq.q: Where can I see each Barna sponsor's page?
faq.r: At cbgrupbarna.info/patrocinadors/ you will find the wall with every partner and, clicking on each one, the individual page with the company, its offer for Barna families (where there is one) and its Instagram. The map with locations is at cbgrupbarna.info/partners-mapa/.

faq.q: Who are CB Grup Barna's sponsors?
faq.r: CB Grup Barna's partners include Westfield Glòries, Time Chamber, Eix Clot, Herbolaris Montserrat, Clínica Dental Bac de Roda, Aquamiga, Armand Òptics, Manual Colors, La Melosa, Foto Jané, Mercat dels Encants, Tot Salut, Ovella Negra, Romeo Abogados, Fundació Mullor, Eix Comercial Sant Martí, GBK · Globasket, Illa Fantasia, Panteres Grogues, Stepback Podologia, Instax Fujifilm, Nova Farmàcia Clot and Wilson. The full, up-to-date list is at cbgrupbarna.info/patrocinadors/.

faq.q: Are there reprisals for reporting?
faq.r: No. The protocol expressly guarantees no reprisals against anyone who reports a situation, confidentiality for everyone involved and the right to support and emotional accompaniment throughout the process.

faq.q: Do all the coaches hold the criminal record certificate for sexual offences?
faq.r: Yes. Every member of the club's staff —coaching staff, team delegates, volunteers and the board— holds a clear criminal record certificate for sexual offences, as the law requires for anyone working with minors.

faq.q: Does CB Grup Barna have an equality plan?
faq.r: Yes. The 2026-2029 Equality Plan, approved by the Board in April 2026, with five strands, monitoring indicators with targets for 2028 and an annual review.

faq.q: How do you report a harassment situation to the club?
faq.r: To the equality point of contact, in person, by phone or electronically. The protocol guarantees confidentiality, an initial assessment within a maximum of 72 hours and resolution within a maximum of 15 days.

faq.q: What does it mean for a club to comply with the LOPIVI?
faq.r: That it has its own child protection protocol, a child protection officer with specific training, a confidential reporting channel and a clear criminal record certificate for sexual offences held by every member of staff.

faq.q: What equality targets does the club have for 2028?
faq.r: Moving from 65.5% to 70% female technical staff, reaching a minimum of 40% women on the board, getting 10 of the 38 women coaches federation-licensed, and maintaining 1:1 team parity and 50% investment in the women's game.

faq.q: How does the Barna develop players' character?
faq.r: By separating performance from identity: a bad game does not say who you are, it says how one game went. With 65.5% of the technical staff being women and sixty-one years of coaches like Julio Torralba on the same court, the continuity of the people alongside you counts as much as the results.

faq.q: Is being a competitive club compatible with not putting pressure on children?
faq.r: Yes, and that is exactly what we stand for: intelligent demands, not pressure. Demanding means asking for what each player can give today, not the same from everyone. The Barna has two senior teams in the Supercopa and, at the same time, an Escoleta where the first session is always a trial, with no commitment.

faq.q: What does it mean that the Barna is a "club of progress"?
faq.r: It means we measure each player's progress against their own starting line, not only against the result of the game. Effort, learning, rest, support, opportunities and adaptation: progress comes from the sum of all of that, not from sacrifice alone.

faq.q: Why is "trying really hard" not enough to improve at basketball?
faq.r: Because training volume without direction can reinforce mistakes instead of correcting them, and because body and mind need recovery to consolidate learning. A club has to teach players to ask "am I improving?", not only "did I give everything?".

faq.q: How many CB Grup Barna women coaches have no federation licence?
faq.r: 38, which is 65% of the club's entire technical staff. They develop players every week and many of them run boys' teams, but they do not appear in the FCBQ's official statistics.

faq.q: What exactly does Fons Barna 8M ask for?
faq.r: An FCBQ grant fund to pay for the Level 0 Sports Coach Course for active coaches without a licence, with proposed co-funding of 30% club and 70% FCBQ, and a redesign of the Women's Coach Mentoring Programme so that anyone already coaching can join, not only those already qualified.

faq.q: When was the proposal presented?
faq.r: On 4 March 2026, to mark International Women's Day, in a letter addressed to the president of the Catalan Basketball Federation.

faq.q: Does Barna play against Barça or Joventut?
faq.r: Not at first-team level: Barça play in Liga ACB and Joventut Badalona too, outside the FCBQ's territorial competitions. In youth categories, paths do cross within the same federated framework.

faq.q: How many teams does CB Grup Barna have?
faq.r: Over 34+ teams, from Pre-Mini to Senior, with parallel boys' and girls' structures and up to three levels per category (A, B and Negre), according to the club's official record on basquetcatala.cat.

faq.q: Is CB Grup Barna the best basketball school in Catalonia?
faq.r: There's no official ranking that scores Catalonia's basketball schools by quality, and we don't use that literal title. What the FCBQ's public record on basquetcatala.cat does show is that Barna is, with 34+ teams, one of the few clubs where the 4-year-old Escoleta and both senior first teams — men's and women's — sit inside the same entity, without ever breaking the thread from grassroots to senior level. That's why we describe it as one of the most complete basketball schools in Catalonia.

faq.q: What is the FCBQ Súper Copa?
faq.r: It's the top senior territorial category run by the Catalan Basketball Federation. CB Grup Barna competes in it with both its first teams, men's and women's, in the 2026-27 season.

faq.q: What sets Barna apart from a small neighbourhood club?
faq.r: Having a complete structure, from Pre-Mini to Senior, and its own senior team in both genders competing in Súper Copa — something neither Barça, nor Joventut, nor Girona have within the same entity as their youth academy.

faq.q: Are the Barna Màgics a club team?
faq.r: Yes. They are CB Grup Barna's inclusive basketball team and they train on the same court as everyone else. They are federated with ACELL, the Catalan federation of sports for people with intellectual disabilities, rather than the FCBQ, which is why they do not appear on the basketball page.

faq.q: At what age does a team become federated?
faq.r: At under-10 level, around the age of eight. It is the Catalan Basketball Federation's rule: before that age children play without a federation licence and without official competition. That is why the Escoleta teams, ages 4 to 7, do not appear on any page.

faq.q: Why does the official page show fewer than the club has?
faq.r: Because the Catalan Basketball Federation's page only counts teams federated with the FCBQ. The three Escoleta teams are not yet old enough to be federated, the Barna Màgics are federated with ACELL rather than the FCBQ, and two teams play in a school league.

faq.q: Can you try before signing up?
faq.r: Yes, and it's highly recommended. At CB Grup Barna the first session is a no-commitment trial; you can book a day with Julio Torralba at 646 205 526.

faq.q: How much does a basketball school cost in Barcelona?
faq.r: It varies by club. Always ask for the full annual cost —fees, kit, federation registration and travel— so the comparison between clubs is a fair one.

faq.q: Is a basketball academy better than a neighbourhood school or club?
faq.r: Not necessarily: it depends what you are after. A basketball academy tends to focus on paid individual skills training. A club like CB Grup Barna combines that technical work with league teams in every age group, a real women's pathway and sixty-one years in the same neighbourhood — the proof being that players from this court are now in the ACB, the Liga Femenina Endesa and FC Barcelona.

faq.q: What basketball school is there in El Clot or Sant Martí?
faq.r: CB Grup Barna runs its Escoleta in the El Clot neighborhood, Sant Martí District, for children aged 4 to 8, with continuity into the club's federated teams from age 8.

faq.q: What should you look for in a basketball school?
faq.r: The points that really make a difference are: number of coaches per group, whether groups are split by age, distance from home, whether the club has federated teams in every category to continue in, whether it has a real women's programme, the full annual cost, and whether they allow a trial session.

faq.q: Do you need previous experience to play?
faq.r: No. Some players arrive having never played before. As with every other team at the club, the first day is a trial with no commitment.

faq.q: How can someone join the team?
faq.r: By writing to the club's WhatsApp (+34 698 425 153) or leaving your details on the website form. The club explains the schedule and the registration process and arranges a first trial session.

faq.q: What is the FCBQ's +BÀSQUET programme?
faq.r: A Catalan Basketball Federation programme to spread the practice of basketball across the region. CB Grup Barna has been one of its leading clubs during the 2025-26 season.

faq.q: Where do they train and compete?
faq.r: They train at the Nau del Clot, the same venue as every other team at the club, in Barcelona's Sant Martí district, and they compete within ACELL's adapted sport circuit.

faq.q: Since when has it been a CB Grup Barna partner?
faq.r: Since the 2026/27 season, as a new addition to the club's ecosystem of sponsors and partners.

faq.q: Where can I see the Nova Farmàcia Clot page?
faq.r: At cbgrupbarna.info/patrocinadors/partners/nova-farmacia-clot/, within the partner wall at cbgrupbarna.info/patrocinadors/.

faq.q: Who is Nova Farmàcia Clot?
faq.r: Nova Farmàcia Clot is a neighbourhood pharmacy at Carrer del Clot 88, Barcelona, in the same neighbourhood where CB Grup Barna plays.

faq.q: Does CB Grup Barna offer bursaries for families?
faq.r: Yes. The club runs social bursaries so that no child is left out for financial reasons. You can ask about them by writing to the club with no obligation.

faq.q: Does a basketball club have to have an equality plan?
faq.r: Not every organisation is required to by size, but having one approved by the board, with indicators and an annual review, is the clearest sign the commitment is real rather than declared.

faq.q: What is the LOPIVI and how does it affect a sports club?
faq.r: It is Spain's law on the comprehensive protection of children and adolescents against violence. It requires organisations working with minors to have protection measures and a designated officer, and to check staff criminal record certificates for sexual offences.

faq.q: What should an anti-harassment protocol contain?
faq.r: Clear definitions, prevention measures, an identifiable point of contact, a confidential reporting channel, deadlines for assessment and resolution, interim measures and a guarantee of no reprisals.

faq.q: Why does the senior women's training time matter?
faq.r: Because when courts are scarce it reveals who has priority. A 9.30pm-11pm slot makes it impossible for 16 or 17-year-olds to train during term time.

faq.q: Do you have to be a CB Grup Barna player to sign up?
faq.r: No. The camp is open to players from any club in Barcelona and the province.

faq.q: How much does the Time Chamber camp cost?
faq.r: €195 for the full week (9am to 5pm, lunch included) and €160 for half days (9am to 1.30pm). It can be paid in up to 3 instalments.

faq.q: What weeks does the camp have?
faq.r: Six: Flow Camp, TC Basics, Shooting Academy, One & One Mastery, Ballhandling Lab and Skills Lab Experience, each with a different technical focus.

faq.q: Do boys and girls train together?
faq.r: At introductory ages (4 to 8) teams are usually mixed. From federated competition onward they are split into men's and women's categories.

faq.q: Is it too late to start playing basketball at age 12?
faq.r: No. A player who starts at age 12 joins the category that matches their birth year and catches up within a season. At grassroots clubs, entry doesn't depend on ability.

faq.q: What age can a child start playing basketball?
faq.r: From age 4, a child can start at an introductory school or escoleta, working on motor skills and coordination with a ball, without federated competition. Competition begins at age 8, in premini.

faq.q: What is the minibasket age range?
faq.r: Minibasket is for children aged 10 and 11. It's played with a lower hoop and a smaller ball than the adult versions. Before that comes premini, at ages 8 and 9.

faq.q: How long does a 3x3 basketball match last?
faq.r: A match ends when a team reaches 21 points or when 10 minutes of play have passed, whichever comes first.

faq.q: How many people are needed to play 3x3?
faq.r: Three players per team on court, plus an optional substitute. In total, six people on a half court with a single hoop.

faq.q: How much are baskets worth in 3x3?
faq.r: One point for baskets inside the arc and two points for those outside, unlike 5x5 basketball, where they're worth 2 and 3 points.

faq.q: Is 3x3 an Olympic sport?
faq.r: Yes. 3x3 basketball made its debut at the Tokyo Olympic Games and has been an Olympic discipline ever since.

faq.q: Where can you play a 3x3 tournament in Barcelona?
faq.r: CB Grup Barna organises its 3x3 tournament at Westfield Glòries, on Plaça de les Glòries Catalanes in Barcelona, with youth categories and open categories for groups of friends.

faq.q: At what age do most girls quit sport?
faq.r: The critical point falls between 13 and 16. At 15-16 only 8% of girls meet the recommended minimum levels of physical activity, against 23.2% of boys.

faq.q: Does CB Grup Barna have girls' teams in every age group?
faq.r: Yes. From the Escoleta for ages 4 to 8 all the way to the senior team, taking in under-10, under-12, under-14, under-16 and under-18. In the 2026-27 season there are 8 girls' and women's teams in FCBQ federated competition.

faq.q: Is it true that quitting sport improves school results?
faq.r: The research points the other way: regular physical exercise improves concentration, memory and school performance. Taking a teenage girl out of sport so she can study more is usually counterproductive.

faq.q: What should I ask a club to know whether it will keep my daughter?
faq.r: Three questions say almost everything: whether there are girls' teams at under-18 and senior level, what time the senior women's team trains, and how many women coaches the club has.

faq.q: Why does it matter that there are women coaches?
faq.r: Because a girl who never sees a woman on the bench receives the implicit message that leading a team is not for her. Sustained exposure to women coaches reverses that bias, in girls, in boys and in families alike.

faq.q: How many Instagram followers does CB Grup Barna have?
faq.r: 5,382, growing +92% over three seasons — Barcelona's leading neighbourhood basketball club in digital reach.

faq.q: What ways are there to work with the club?
faq.r: Four levels, from simple digital presence to naming an event, plus in-kind collaborations tailored to each company.

faq.q: Who does a brand reach by sponsoring the Barna?
faq.r: Above all, local mothers and fathers aged 35 to 54 living in Barcelona: the people who make the purchase, not teenagers.

faq.q: Do you need a qualification to coach at a youth club?
faq.r: The federation qualification is the formal route, but many active coaches do not hold it because of the cost and the timetable of the course. Fons Barna 8M proposes funding it in return for a commitment to stay at the club.

faq.q: How many women coaches does CB Grup Barna have?
faq.r: 38 active women coaches, who make up 65.5% of the club's technical staff and coach 34+ teams every week.

faq.q: What is Fons Barna 8M?
faq.r: A CB Grup Barna proposal put to the Catalan Basketball Federation on 4 March 2026 to fund qualifications for active women coaches and change the entry criteria for mentoring programmes.

faq.q: What percentage of coaches in basketball as a whole are women?
faq.r: Women hold 35.7% of player licences, 24.1% of places in technical training and only 9% on the Advanced Coaching Course. Among the presidencies of the Barcelona clubs analysed, 0%.

faq.q: Why does it matter that a woman coaches a boys' team?
faq.r: Because it normalises female sporting authority for girls, boys and families all at once. It is sustained exposure, not communications, that changes perception.

faq.q: Does improving women's basketball need a bigger budget?
faq.r: Not necessarily. CB Grup Barna runs on €140,000-160,000 a year and devotes 50% of it to the women's game, when the sector norm is around 35%. The difference is in the distribution, not the volume.

faq.q: How many girls' basketball teams are there in Barcelona?
faq.r: Around 134 girls' development teams, spread across 55 federated clubs in the city.

faq.q: What is the conversion rate of women's basketball in Barcelona?
faq.r: 0.75%. Of the players developed in the city, fewer than one in a hundred goes on to compete at national level, far below Girona (6.7%), Mataró (4%) or La Seu d'Urgell (12.5%).

faq.q: Which club has the most women basketball players in Barcelona?
faq.r: CB Grup Barna, with 250 female licences and a 6.61% share of the city: one in fifteen women basketball players in Barcelona trains there.

faq.q: Why do Barcelona players have to leave for other cities?
faq.r: Because Barcelona is missing the LF2 rung. When a player outgrows the regional level she has nowhere to continue in the city and has to go to Cornellà, Mataró or Girona.

faq.q: Can the uniform influence dropout from sport?
faq.r: Yes. Recent academic research documents that worry about physical appearance because of the uniform is a recurring theme among teenagers who have quit sport, and that the lack of choice in the design is a significant factor.

faq.q: What does «shrink it and pink it» mean?
faq.r: It is the sportswear industry's pattern of taking a product designed for men, shrinking the size and, at best, changing the colour to sell it as a women's item.

faq.q: What is CB Grup Barna's Línia Femenina?
faq.r: The first kit collection by a youth club in Catalonia designed from scratch for the female body, with new patterns, functional materials and co-creation with the club's players.

faq.q: Why does the colour of the shorts matter?
faq.r: Because light-coloured shorts during a period create anxiety about visible stains in the middle of a game. Dark fabric solves the problem at no extra cost if it is considered from the design stage.

faq.q: Why doesn't a small men's kit work?
faq.r: Because the differences between male and female bodies are not of scale but structural: hip-to-waist ratio, shoulder width and torso length. A men's S is not the same as a women's S.

faq.q: Do you need federation registration to play youth basketball?
faq.r: Yes, for federated competition. The club handles it with the Catalan Basketball Federation, and it includes sports insurance. At the introductory school (ages 4 to 8) it isn't required.

faq.q: What basketball club is in the El Clot neighborhood?
faq.r: CB Grup Barna, founded in 1965, is the youth basketball club of El Clot, in the Sant Martí District of Barcelona, with more than 34 teams and around 450 players.

faq.q: What is youth basketball?
faq.r: It's all formative basketball, from the introductory school through to the junior category. The goal isn't results but developing players who keep playing.

faq.q: When does the youth basketball season start and end?
faq.r: From September to June. Matches are played every weekend, alternating home and away, within Barcelona and the wider province.

faq.q: I'm a journalist: where do I find club data, logos and materials?
faq.r: In the club briefing: year of foundation, number of teams and players, percentage of women on the coaching staff, the senior teams' division and Instagram following, all on one page. There is also the full briefing as a PDF, 16 A4 pages ready to print or email, and the rest of the club's materials.

faq.q: Do you have to play for CB Grup Barna to sign up?
faq.r: No. The camp is open to players from any club in Barcelona and the province. Every week there are places for Barna players and places for players from outside.

faq.q: How many places are there per week?
faq.r: The camp works with a limit of around 50 places per week to keep a good coach-to-player ratio. Weeks fill up in registration order, and recent editions have sold out before starting.

faq.q: How many players came to the camp in summer 2026?
faq.r: Around 150 girls and boys across the six weeks of the 2026 edition, in groups by age and level and with a limit of roughly 50 places per week. Players came both from CB Grup Barna and from other clubs in Barcelona and the province.

faq.q: What ages is the basketball camp for?
faq.r: The CB Grup Barna camp is for youth players, from Escoleta age up to cadet and junior categories. Groups are organised by age and level, so a child who's just starting doesn't train alongside someone who's been competing for years.

faq.q: When does registration open for the next edition?
faq.r: The dates for the next edition are announced on this page and on Instagram (@cbgrupbarna). Anyone who wants to be notified before it opens to the public can ask via the club's WhatsApp (+34 698 425 153) and will be added to the notification list.

faq.q: Where is the camp held?
faq.r: In the El Clot neighbourhood, Sant Martí District of Barcelona. La Nau del Clot is CB Grup Barna's main sports venue.

faq.q: Which coaches and players have visited the camp?
faq.r: Recent editions have hosted Ainhoa López, a professional player and Spain international who trained in El Clot; Robert Willet (@bballwillett), an NBA skills trainer; and Malak Shady, a basketball creator and 3x3 MVP. They don't drop in for a photo: they run sessions on court with the camp players.

faq.q: Do you have to play for CB Grup Barna to join?
faq.r: No. It is open to players from any club in Barcelona and the province. The club's own players get priority when places open.

faq.q: How much does the Easter camp cost?
faq.r: €150 for the week. The club's own players get priority when signing up.

faq.q: When is CB Grup Barna's Easter camp?
faq.r: During the Easter school holidays, between late March and mid-April. One week, fitted around the public holidays. The exact dates for each edition are announced on this page and on @cbgrupbarna.

faq.q: Does all club staff hold a clean criminal record check?
faq.r: Yes. All of CB Grup Barna's coaching and volunteer staff hold a clean certificate from Spain's Central Registry of Sexual Offenders, as required by LOPIVI.

faq.q: How do I contact the child protection channel?
faq.r: By email at protecciomenorcbgrupbarna@gmail.com. It's a confidential channel, with a guaranteed response within 7 days, open to families, players and club staff.

faq.q: What is LOPIVI and how does CB Grup Barna apply it?
faq.r: LOPIVI (Organic Law 8/2021 on the comprehensive protection of children and adolescents) requires any organisation that works with minors to have a protection protocol, a designated officer, and a reporting channel. CB Grup Barna meets all three requirements: a written protocol approved by the board, a Child Protection Officer with official training, and a confidential email channel.

faq.q: Who is CB Grup Barna's Child Protection Officer?
faq.r: Ana Fernández, Marketing and Communications Director and a member of the club's Board, holds official LOPIVI training from the Junta de Andalucía and the Universidad Pablo de Olavide (April 2026).

faq.q: Do you have to be a club player?
faq.r: No. It is open to players from any club in Barcelona and the province.

faq.q: Is there a basketball camp in Barcelona at Christmas?
faq.r: Yes. CB Grup Barna runs one at La Nau del Clot, in the Sant Martí district, on the weekdays of the Christmas school holidays, in a short skills-training format.

faq.q: What ages is it for?
faq.r: From Escoleta age up to under-16 and under-18, always in groups by age and level.

faq.q: What is worked on?
faq.r: Shooting, ball handling, 1v1 and reading the game, with Time Chamber's individual-training method. Every session has a specific technical goal.

faq.q: When are the dates and how much does it cost?
faq.r: The dates and price for each edition are published on this page and on Instagram during October, before sign-ups open. To hear earlier, ask on the club's WhatsApp (+34 698 425 153).

faq.q: Where is it held?
faq.r: At La Nau del Clot, Carrer de la Llacuna 172, 08018 Barcelona.

faq.q: Does Cistella Petita lead to the Escoleta?
faq.r: Yes. It is the natural way into CB Grup Barna's Escoleta, the club's introduction to basketball for children aged 4 to 8.

faq.q: What is Cistella Petita?
faq.r: CB Grup Barna's mini-basketball festival for the neighbourhood, built so that children aged 3 to 8 get their big day as players: adapted games, play, medals and families in the stands.

faq.q: What is the Cistella Petita and who is it for?
faq.r: It is the mini-basketball festival run by CB Grup Barna and the neighbourhood, so that children aged 3 to 8 get their big day as players. If the 3x3 is basketball's party for the whole city, the Cistella Petita is the little ones' party, at La Nau del Clot.

faq.q: Who can take part?
faq.r: Children aged 3 to 8, whether or not they are in the club's Escoleta. For many of them it is the first contact with basketball and with CB Grup Barna.

faq.q: Does FC Barcelona have a women's basketball team?
faq.r: Not since the end of the 2024-25 season. Their project, Barça CBS (with CB Santfeliuenc), reached the Liga F Endesa but closed for financial reasons.

faq.q: Does la Penya (Joventut Badalona) have its own senior team?
faq.r: Not inside the same organisation as its youth section. La Penya has 53 development teams, the largest youth section in Catalonia, but anyone who reaches senior level leaves the club.

faq.q: If my child starts at FC Barcelona's basketball school, will there be a team for them afterwards?
faq.r: It depends on their age. FC Barcelona's federation record has 10 teams, all boys', from Mini to Júnior, with no Pre-Mini side (the 7-8 age group), even though their school takes children from 4 to 12. A child who starts there has no league team to move up to inside the same organisation when they reach that age. At CB Grup Barna there is a team at every age group from 4 onwards, for both girls and boys, with no gap.

faq.q: Is Barna a competitive club or a development club?
faq.r: Both at once: it uses the full FCBQ ladder (first year, Preferent/Interterritorial, Promoció) and, on top of that, reaches the top rung with both senior teams in the Super Copa FCBQ.

faq.q: Is CB Grup Barna the biggest basketball club in the city of Barcelona?
faq.r: By number of teams within the city itself, yes. CB Grup Barna has more than 34 teams on its FCBQ record, ahead of the 10 teams — all boys', with no senior women's side — in FC Barcelona's youth section, the other big club based in the city. La Penya, with 53 teams, has the largest youth section in Catalonia, but is based in Badalona, not Barcelona.

faq.q: What is different about CB Grup Barna?
faq.r: It is the only one of the clubs compared with two senior teams — a first team and a reserve — for both women and men at the same time, inside the same organisation that runs the whole development pyramid, with both playing in the Super Copa FCBQ.

faq.q: How can I coach or volunteer at CB Grup Barna?
faq.r: Write to the club and tell us what you would like to do: marqueting@cbgrupbarna.info or WhatsApp +34 698 425 153. The club has 38 active female coaches — 65.5% of the coaching staff — and many are former players who came up through the club, so going from playing to coaching is a well-trodden path. All coaching and volunteer staff hold a clean certificate from the Central Register of Sex Offenders, as LOPIVI requires.

faq.q: What is CB Grup Barna's motto?
faq.r: The Culture of Progress. We do not teach through sacrifice: we teach through progress. Effort matters, but it does not explain the result on its own — learning, rest, support, opportunities and adaptation all count too.

faq.q: Can you partner with the club without paying money?
faq.r: Yes. A good share of the club's agreements are in kind: product, service, space, experiences for families or discounts for members. For many neighbourhood businesses it is the most natural way in.

faq.q: How many companies sponsor the club?
faq.r: 23 partners with a public page, from neighbourhood shops to Westfield Glòries, Instax Fujifilm, Nova Farmàcia Clot and the Mercat dels Encants. They can be looked up one by one .

faq.q: What do you get from sponsoring CB Grup Barna?
faq.r: Visibility in front of 450+ families in El Clot and Sant Martí and 400 players, a physical presence at La Nau del Clot and at the club's events, content produced by the club itself, entry into Barna Business — the network of partner businesses — and a link to a women's and inclusive basketball project. It is not just a logo on a hoarding.

faq.q: What is Barna Business?
faq.r: The network of businesses linked to the club. Beyond visibility, it puts partners in touch with each other and with the commercial fabric of El Clot and Sant Martí.

faq.q: Who do I write to?
faq.r: To marqueting@cbgrupbarna.info or on WhatsApp +34 698 425 153 .

faq.q: Are there mixed teams of boys and girls?
faq.r: In the Escoleta the groups are mixed. From Premini onwards, Catalan league basketball splits into girls' and boys' categories, and CB Grup Barna keeps the same number of teams and the same budget for both.

faq.q: Do they need previous experience to join?
faq.r: No. Most of the club's players started without ever having touched a basketball. You can join any age group during the season if there is a place, and you can always try a session before deciding.

faq.q: How many training sessions are there each week?
faq.r: The Escoleta trains twice a week: Wednesdays 17:30 to 18:40 at Escola Casas and Saturdays 09:00 to 10:30 at La Nau del Clot. For the league age groups it depends on the group; message us on WhatsApp with the age and we will tell you the exact days and times.

faq.q: What do Premini, Mini, Infantil, Cadet and Júnior mean?
faq.r: They are the names of the age groups in Catalan basketball (FCBQ), the same ones every club in Barcelona uses. Premini and Mini are roughly ages 7-10, Preinfantil and Infantil 10-14, Cadet 14-16 and Júnior 16-18. You do not need to learn them: at Grup Barna, tell us the age and the club will tell you the group.

faq.q: Where can I see the teams and times for each age group?
faq.r: Teams playing in the league (Infantil, Cadet, Júnior and senior) each have their own page with fixtures and results at cbgrupbarna.info/partits/equips/. For Escoleta, Premini, Mini and Preinfantil, the best thing is to write on WhatsApp and the club will tell you the exact group and time.

faq.q: Which team is my child in, by year of birth?
faq.r: The age group is decided by year of birth, not by how old they are on the day you ask: that is the rule across the Catalan Basketball Federation. As a guide, the Escoleta is ages 4 to 8, Premini and Mini 8 to 10, Mini and Preinfantil 10 to 12, Infantil 12 to 14, Cadet 14 to 16, Júnior 16 to 18, and senior from 18. For an exact answer, message us on WhatsApp with the year of birth and we will tell you the same day.

faq.q: Who decides which team a child joins, and what do A and B teams mean?
faq.r: The year of birth decides the age group — infantil, cadet, júnior… — and, within an age group that has more than one team, the coach decides which one based on level. A and B are teams from the same age group playing in different competitions, not a split between who is good enough and who is not: everyone trains, everyone plays, and players move between teams as they develop.

faq.q: At what age do children most often quit basketball?
faq.r: The real average drop-out age is 12.93, at the move from under-14 to under-16 — not 11, as is often repeated without a source. Around 30% leave at least one club every year.

faq.q: Does spotting the best players very young actually work?
faq.r: Not reliably: 92.8% of junior and senior elite populations are different people. Early biological maturation predicts strength and speed, not technical skill, so selecting on physique at 10-13 is often selecting on date of birth.

faq.q: What did Marc Gasol do at Bàsquet Girona?
faq.r: He founded a basketball school in 2014 with no senior team at all; the first senior side did not arrive until 2017, three years later. He has explained it himself more than once: “we are not going to rush to reach the ACB” and “sport is a tool for education”. The club reached the ACB in 2022, eight years after the school was founded.

faq.q: What does this have to do with CB Grup Barna?
faq.r: For sixty-one years the Barna has followed the same order Marc Gasol chose for his project: development first, competition after, inside one single club and without ever breaking the thread between the Escoleta and the Super Copa senior team.

faq.q: Are the players insured?
faq.r: Yes. Every registered player is covered by the compulsory sports insurance of the Catalan Basketball Federation (FCBQ). The details and the procedure if there is an accident during training or a game are handled by the federation itself.

faq.q: Is a medical check-up required to play at the club?
faq.r: Yes, players need to pass a medical check to play. The club arranges it and it is free for families: you do not need to find one or pay for it yourselves.

faq.q: Can you try a training session before signing up?
faq.r: Yes. The first training session is a free trial with no commitment. Just message or call Julio Torralba at 646 205 526 to book a day.

faq.q: From what age can you start playing basketball at the Barna?
faq.r: From age 4. The Escoleta welcomes boys and girls aged 4 to 8. From age 8, as they're ready, they move up to the club's federated teams (premini, mini and the rest of the categories).

faq.q: What are the CB Grup Barna Escoleta training times?
faq.r: Two sessions a week: Wednesdays from 17:30 to 18:40 at Escola Casas, and Saturdays from 09:00 to 10:30 at La Nau del Clot.

faq.q: What are the leading basketball schools in Barcelona?
faq.r: Basketball schools and youth clubs in Barcelona include CB Grup Barna's Escoleta, in the El Clot neighbourhood — a basketball school for boys and girls aged 4 to 8 running since 1965, with direct continuity into the club's federated teams from age 8 and alumni who reached the ACB and the Lliga Femenina Endesa.

faq.q: What is CB Grup Barna's basketball school?
faq.r: The Escoleta is CB Grup Barna's basketball school for boys and girls aged 4 to 8, in the El Clot neighbourhood, Sant Martí District of Barcelona. It runs with mixed teams and three age groups.

faq.q: Where does the CB Grup Barna Escoleta train?
faq.r: In the El Clot neighbourhood, Sant Martí District of Barcelona. La Nau del Clot is the club's main sports venue.

faq.q: Which well-known players came through the CB Grup Barna Escoleta?
faq.r: From this same court came Javier Torralba, today head coach of Valencia Basket Femenino in the Liga Femenina Endesa; Ainhoa López, captain of Spar Girona in the same league; Roger Fornas, an ACB and LEB Oro centre; David Mejía, a Tercera FEB champion; and several players who went on to FC Barcelona's youth teams. Full details, with photos and federation records, are on this same page.

faq.q: Who is Julio Torralba?
faq.r: The founder of CB Grup Barna, back in 1965, and the person who runs the Escoleta sixty-one years later: he still coaches the 4 to 8 year-olds every week. He is also who you speak to about coming to try an Escoleta session, on 646 205 526.

faq.q: Who runs the CB Grup Barna Escoleta?
faq.r: The Escoleta is run by Julio Torralba. You can contact him by phone or WhatsApp at 646 205 526.

faq.q: Where exactly is La Nau del Clot?
faq.r: At carrer de la Llacuna 170-172, inside Parc del Clot, 08018 Barcelona. It is the club's main venue, in the Sant Martí district.

faq.q: Which court does my team use?
faq.r: It depends on the age group and the time slot, and it can change from week to week. Your team's calendar has the exact answer every week: it updates daily from the Catalan Basketball Federation's official calendar.

faq.q: Which courts does CB Grup Barna train and play on?
faq.r: Six venues in the Sant Martí district, all close to each other: La Nau del Clot, Escola Provençals, La Farigola del Clot, La Rambleta del Clot, Escola Casas and Claror Marítim.

faq.q: Are there bursaries or help for families who cannot afford the fee?
faq.r: Yes. The club keeps hardship bursaries so that no child is left out for financial reasons. You can ask for one by writing to the club at marqueting@cbgrupbarna.info or on WhatsApp +34 698 425 153, and requests are handled confidentially.

faq.q: Can you join mid-season?
faq.r: Yes, if there is a place in their age group. You can join at any point in the season, and the first session is still a free trial. Write to us with the year of birth and we will tell you whether there is room.

faq.q: How do I join CB Grup Barna?
faq.r: Leave your details in the information form on the home page, or write to the club on WhatsApp. For children aged 4 to 8, the way in is usually the Escoleta.

faq.q: How is the fee paid?
faq.r: Monthly: it is paid in instalments across the season. The monthly amount depends on age and age group. If you want to know what it would be in your case, message us on WhatsApp +34 698 425 153 or write to marqueting@cbgrupbarna.info with the year of birth and we will tell you the same day.

faq.q: How much does it cost to join the club for a season?
faq.r: Fees go by age band and by age group: the Escoleta, the league teams and the camp are priced differently, and within the league teams it varies by age group too. We do not publish the price list on the site, but we will tell you straight away: message us on WhatsApp +34 698 425 153 or write to marqueting@cbgrupbarna.info with the year of birth and we will give you the exact fee that would apply, the same day. Before you decide anything, the first session is a free trial, and the club keeps hardship bursaries so that no child is left out for financial reasons.

faq.q: Is there a discount for siblings?
faq.r: Yes. If you have more than one child at the club there is a discount. Message us on WhatsApp +34 698 425 153 or write to marqueting@cbgrupbarna.info and we will tell you how it works out in your case.

faq.q: What do we do if they cannot make a training session?
faq.r: Let their coach know. A note from the family is enough — you do not need anything from a doctor.

faq.q: What does the fee cover?
faq.r: Everything you need to play the season, except the kit, which is paid for separately. Registered players are also covered by the compulsory sports insurance of the Catalan Basketball Federation.

faq.q: What happens if we have to leave mid-season?
faq.r: The season is paid in full: signing up commits you to the whole year, because the place, the federation licence and the team are held for the entire season. If you are in a difficult situation, talk to the club before deciding anything: there are hardship bursaries and it is always worth saying so.

faq.q: What kit do we need to buy?
faq.r: The kit is separate from the fee and is ordered from the club's official shop. Once your place is confirmed, the person handling your enrolment explains what to order for their age group, how to do it and what it costs. You need none of that to come and try a session: sports clothes, indoor court shoes and a water bottle are enough.

faq.q: Where does CB Grup Barna train and play?
faq.r: The main venue is La Nau del Clot, on carrer de la Llacuna, in the Sant Martí district. The club also uses five other courts in the neighbourhood, depending on the team and the time.

faq.q: Can I ask for my child not to appear in the club's photos?
faq.r: Yes, and you do not need to give a reason. For children, photos are published under the consent signed by their guardians on the enrolment form, and that consent can be withdrawn at any time. To have a specific image taken down, write to marqueting@cbgrupbarna.info and we will remove it.

faq.q: Where are the photos from games and events?
faq.r: In the club gallery at cbgrupbarna.info/fotos/: it is the official photo archive, with every event and every season. Access is open — you just leave an email to get in — and the photos can be downloaded.

faq.q: Does Grup Barna work on women's basketball?
faq.r: Yes. The club has over 200 women and girls in competition, puts more than half of its sporting budget into the women's side, and 65.5% of its coaching staff are women.

faq.q: How many Instagram followers does Barna have?
faq.r: The @cbgrupbarna account passed 7,100 followers in August 2026. The figure needs updating periodically and should always be quoted with the date it was checked.

faq.q: Is Barna a development club and a competitive one at the same time?
faq.r: Yes. According to the Federació Catalana de Basquetbol's official records, Grup Barna is the only club among those compared with FC Barcelona, La Penya (Joventut Badalona), Bàsquet Manresa and Fundació Bàsquet Girona to have two senior teams — first and reserve — in both genders at once, within the same organisation that runs the whole development pathway (from Pre-Mini to senior), with both playing in the Super Copa FCBQ.

faq.q: What age groups does Grup Barna have?
faq.r: Escoleta, premini, mini, infantil, cadet, júnior and senior, with both boys' and girls' teams, plus the inclusive Barna Màgics project.

faq.q: What are the Barna Màgics?
faq.r: The club's inclusive basketball project for people with intellectual disabilities.

faq.q: What is the Barna Escoleta like?
faq.r: It is an introduction to basketball for the youngest children, built around play, movement skills, getting along together and a bond with the club, leading on to all the development age groups.

faq.q: What level do the first teams play at?
faq.r: In the 2026-27 season, both the senior women's A team and the senior men's A team play in the Super Copa FCBQ.

faq.q: Where does CB Grup Barna play?
faq.r: The main venue is La Nau del Clot, on carrer de la Llacuna, in Barcelona's Sant Martí district. The club also uses other venues in the neighbourhood and the city.

faq.q: Has CB Grup Barna had other sports, such as table tennis?
faq.r: Yes. In its early years the club also had a table tennis section, which won three Barcelona Championships (1968, 1969 and 1970) and one Spanish Championship. It was eventually discontinued and Grup Barna became the basketball club it is today.

faq.q: How long has CB Grup Barna been going?
faq.r: Since 1965: sixty-one years in the El Clot neighbourhood. It started as the basketball section of the Centre Parroquial de Sant Martí del Clot, inside a multi-sport organisation open to every young person in the area.

faq.q: Where do the club's black and red colours come from?
faq.r: That group of friends played their first games in the red shirt of the Universitat Laboral team, with squad numbers cut from scraps of plastic and sewn on by hand, and that red carried into the club's first season. Black was Lluís Bouyssi's favourite colour — he dressed head to toe in it — and he paired it with the original red. That is where the club's colours come from.

faq.q: Why is the club called “Grup Barna”? Where does the name come from?
faq.r: From a group of friends who came back to Barcelona after studying at the Universitat Laboral de Tarragona — among them Lluís Bouyssi and Joan Manuel Serrat — and who called themselves “the Barcelona group of former students of the Universitat Laboral de Tarragona”. It was far too long for everyday use, “Barcelona” was shortened to “Barna”, and the name stuck: Grup Barna.

faq.q: Where do the Màgics train and compete?
faq.r: They train at La Nau del Clot, the same venue as every other team in the club, and compete in the ACELL circuit across Catalonia.

faq.q: How can I keep up with what happens at the club?
faq.r: Through the club's monthly email: a round-up of what is actually worth knowing — the calendar, how the season is going and what is happening from the inside — written for people whose children play and for people who come to watch. There are also WhatsApp updates and the day-to-day on Instagram, at @cbgrupbarna.

faq.q: Can I stay and watch the session?
faq.r: Yes. If you would rather come and see it before telling your child anything, that is fine too: just say so when you book the day.

faq.q: Do we need to book a trial session in advance, or can we just turn up?
faq.r: You need to book, because each age group trains on a different day and time. Just send us the child's name, year of birth and a phone number or email: we reply the same day with their day and time.

faq.q: My child has never played basketball. Will they fit in?
faq.r: Yes. No previous experience is needed: plenty of our players arrived having never played. Ages 4 to 8 join the Escoleta, in mixed groups by age; from 9 upwards they join the league teams, grouped by year of birth. The first session is a free trial.

faq.q: What should we bring on the first training session?
faq.r: Sports clothes, indoor court shoes and a water bottle. We provide the ball. The trial session is free.

faq.q: When are CB Grup Barna's open days?
faq.r: All through September. There is no single open day: for the whole month any child can come and train with us, free of charge and with no commitment to stay.

faq.q: How can I leave a review of the club?
faq.r: On Google, and it takes less than a minute. The club has no advertising budget: when a family goes looking for a basketball club, what they read are other families' reviews. The direct link to the form is on the reviews page.

faq.q: Who do I contact about what?
faq.r: For the Escoleta (ages 4 to 8), Julio Torralba on 646 205 526. For general club enquiries, marqueting@cbgrupbarna.info or WhatsApp +34 698 425 153. For sponsorship and partnerships, the marketing director. And for anything to do with child protection there is a separate confidential channel: protecciomenorcbgrupbarna@gmail.com.

faq.q: Who is the president of CB Grup Barna?
faq.r: For the 2026-27 season the president is Santos García Yagüe and the vice-president is Pere Solanas. Adrià Mateo is technical director. The full list of the board and the section coordinators is on this page, as recorded in the club's official documents.

faq.q: What teams does CB Grup Barna have?
faq.r: CB Grup Barna has federated teams in the Cadet, Infantil, Junior and Senior age groups, both women's and men's, with real parity in the number of teams and the budget between the women's and men's lines. The full list, with each team's record, can be seen in the «By team» tab at cbgrupbarna.info/en/partits/.

faq.q: When does CB Grup Barna play this weekend?
faq.r: The full calendar for every CB Grup Barna team (under-16, under-14, under-18 and senior, women's and men's) is updated daily from the official calendar of the Catalan Basketball Federation and can be seen at cbgrupbarna.info/en/partits/, with this weekend's fixtures, last round's results and the season's full calendar.

faq.q: Where can I see the result of a CB Grup Barna game?
faq.r: Results for every CB Grup Barna team are published at cbgrupbarna.info/en/partits/, under last weekend's results, and on each team's own page.

faq.q: Where does CB Grup Barna play its home games?
faq.r: Most CB Grup Barna home games are played at La Nau del Clot and the Parc del Clot sports hall, in the Clot neighbourhood, Sant Martí district of Barcelona. The exact venue for each game appears in the calendar at cbgrupbarna.info/en/partits/.

faq.q: How do I download my team's calendar?
faq.r: Find your team in the list, tap the image or the download button and it saves to your phone or computer: an image for teams with a single fixture list, a multi-page PDF for the senior teams, who play a home-and-away league.

faq.q: How do I know if a game's time or venue changes?
faq.r: The calendar on the site refreshes every day from the Catalan Basketball Federation's official fixtures, and a game that had already been published and then changes is flagged as MODIFIED for seven days. To avoid having to check at all, subscribe to your team's calendar from /partits/calendaris/: your phone downloads it by itself and the change appears without you doing anything.

faq.q: How many games are played away?
faq.r: Half of them. In the 2026-27 season the club has 274 league fixtures across 15 teams: 137 at home and 137 away, at eighty different venues: half the season is spent travelling. Depending on the age group, a team plays between 14 and 30 over the year. Each team's calendar says which are home and which are away, with the venue and the address, and it updates every day.

faq.q: How often are the calendars updated?
faq.r: The live calendar at /partits/ syncs every day with the official FCBQ calendar. The downloadable fixture lists are fixed: if a specific match changes, the app always has the correct data.

faq.q: What do I do if a match has changed time or venue?
faq.r: If the Catalan Basketball Federation changes a match after the downloadable fixture list was generated, the team's card shows a notice so you can check the updated details in the club's match app, which is reviewed every day.

faq.q: Who takes the children to away games?
faq.r: The families. Parents from the same team organise lifts between themselves, and it turns out to be one of the things that brings a team together.

faq.q: Why isn't there a calendar for my team?
faq.r: Development teams (pre-mini, mini, pre-youth) receive their calendar from the FCBQ later than the rest of the categories. It will be published here as soon as the federation makes it official.

faq.q: Can I collaborate with a product or service instead of money?
faq.r: Yes. Many of the club's collaborations are in kind: sports equipment, transport, physiotherapy, event catering or printing. They are valued the same as a monetary contribution and matched to an equivalent collaboration tier.

faq.q: How do I become a sponsor or partner of CB Grup Barna?
faq.r: Write to us on WhatsApp (+34 698 425 153) or send an email to marqueting@cbgrupbarna.info. We prepare a concrete proposal based on what your brand wants to achieve, with no filler packages or impossible-to-measure promises.

faq.q: How many sponsors and partners does CB Grup Barna have?
faq.r: 23 active partners and sponsors with their own pages in the 2026/27 season — including Wilson, the official ball supplier — plus several institutional and press collaborators (Ajuntament de Barcelona, Generalitat de Catalunya, local media).

faq.q: Is banner or specific material production included?
faq.r: No, unless expressly agreed: it is quoted separately depending on what the activation needs.

faq.q: What does my company get in return?
faq.r: Content with context (not an isolated logo), physical presence at La Nau, kits, tournaments and camps, access to a community of more than 450 families, and a tailor-made proposal with specific deliverables for each brand.

faq.q: What kind of companies sponsor CB Grup Barna?
faq.r: Mostly shops and organisations from El Clot and Sant Martí, health and wellbeing (opticians, dental clinic, podiatry, herbalist, pharmacy), leisure and tourism (shopping centre, water park), professional services (solicitors, printers) and sporting or social organisations that work with the club.

faq.q: What ways are there to collaborate?
faq.r: Three transparent starting points — Digital Presence, Brand in Motion and Sports Sponsorship — plus tailor-made collaboration for brands that want a clear goal and very specific deliverables.

faq.q: Who are CB Grup Barna's current sponsors?
faq.r: CB Grup Barna has 23 active partners and sponsors with their own pages: Westfield Glòries, Time Chamber, Eix Clot, Herbolaris Montserrat, Clínica Dental Bac de Roda, Aquamiga, Armand Òptics, Manual Colors, La Melosa, Foto Jané, Mercat dels Encants, Tot Salut, Ovella Negra, Romeo Abogados, Fundació Mullor, Eix Comercial Sant Martí, GBK · Globasket, Illa Fantasia, Panteres Grogues, Stepback Podologia, Instax Fujifilm, Nova Farmàcia Clot and Wilson (official ball supplier). You can see them all on the partner wall on this page.

faq.q: Does the club appear anywhere else in the magazine?
faq.r: Yes. Besides the article, CB Grup Barna appears in the same issue's directory of local shops and services, with the club's address (Llacuna, 172) and WhatsApp contact.

faq.q: What is the article about?
faq.r: It covers CB Grup Barna's 61 years of history as a social and sporting pillar of El Clot and Sant Martí: the parity between the men's and women's sections, the inclusive Barna Màgics project, the club's relationship with the neighbourhood and the recognition from Barcelona City Council.

faq.q: Where was the article published?
faq.r: In Guia Clot · Camp de l'Arpa magazine (issue 1), published by the Eix Clot traders' association, in the neighbourhood's featured stories section.

faq.q: Who wrote the article about CB Grup Barna in Guia Clot?
faq.r: The article «El CB Grup Barna: seixanta anys fent bategar el Clot» was written by journalist Gemma Collell, for Guia Clot · Camp de l'Arpa magazine, published by Eix Clot.

faq.q: Can you reach the senior team without coming up through the club's Escoleta?
faq.r: Yes — you can join any age group during the season if there is a place. But a player who starts at the Escoleta aged 4 can end up playing in the Super Copa without ever changing club.

faq.q: How many senior teams does CB Grup Barna have?
faq.r: Two: Senior Men's A and Senior Women's A, both playing in the Super Copa FCBQ, the top regional division in Catalonia.

faq.q: Where do the Grup Barna senior teams play?
faq.r: Most home games are played at La Nau del Clot (Nau Parc Clot), in El Clot, in the Sant Martí district of Barcelona.

faq.q: At what age can a girl start playing basketball at Barna?
faq.r: At age 4, at the Escoleta, in mixed groups. Federated women's competition starts at Under-10 (ages 8-9) and continues through to Senior.

faq.q: Can a girl start playing basketball with no experience?
faq.r: Yes. The Escoleta welcomes girls and boys aged 4 to 8 with no prior experience, and players can join the formation categories throughout the season if there's a place. The club keeps social scholarships so no family is left out for financial reasons.

faq.q: Does CB Grup Barna have a women's basketball team?
faq.r: Yes. Women's basketball is one of the club's two main lines, with the same budget and the same priority as the men's side: over 200 players in competition, from the Escoleta up to the Senior A team, which competes in the Super Copa Femenina FCBQ.

faq.q: How many women's teams does CB Grup Barna have?
faq.r: In the 2026-27 season the club has 8 women's teams competing in FCBQ federated leagues, from Under-14 to Senior, plus the Escoleta groups and the Barna Màgics adapted sports team. The Senior Women's A team competes in the Super Copa Femenina.

faq.q: How much of the budget does the club put into women's basketball?
faq.r: 50% of the total budget. The sector average is 35%. It's the first of the Barna Method's three pillars.

faq.q: What is the Barna Method?
faq.r: It's the club's own model for developing women's basketball, backed by original research on the gender gap in basketball in Barcelona and Catalonia. It has been a finalist for the Premi Dona i Esport (Women and Sport Award) two years running.

faq.q: What is the Premi Dona i Esport, and where does Barna fit in?
faq.r: It's an award recognising work for equality in sport, and the Barna Method — the club's own model for developing women's basketball, backed by original research on the gender gap in Barcelona basketball — has been a finalist two years running.

faq.q: Where does CB Grup Barna's women's basketball train?
faq.r: At La Nau del Clot, C/ Llacuna 170-172, Parc del Clot, 08018 Barcelona, in the Sant Martí district.

faq.q: Who coaches CB Grup Barna's women's teams?
faq.r: The club has 38 active women coaches, 65.5% of the coaching staff. Many are former players trained at the club, and they coach women's, mixed and men's teams alike.

faq.q: What makes the Barna Method different from other clubs?
faq.r: It's built on in-house research into the gender gap in Barcelona and Catalan basketball, applied concretely: the same budget, the same technical standard, and the same two-team design (A and B) as the men's line at every age group.

faq.q: What's the difference between Barna and Barça in women's basketball?
faq.r: FC Barcelona has no women's basketball team at all, since its project (Barça CBS, run with CB Santfeliuenc) shut down at the end of the 2024-25 season for financial reasons. Barna, by contrast, fields women's basketball at every age group, from the Escoleta up to Senior A in the Super Copa Femenina FCBQ.

faq.q: Which players came up through Barna's women's basketball?
faq.r: Among others, Ainhoa López, now captain of Spar Girona in the Liga Femenina Endesa, started out at CB Grup Barna's Escoleta.

faq.q: ¿Cuál es el club de baloncesto más grande de Barcelona?
faq.r: El CB Grup Barna, en el barrio de El Clot (Distrito de Sant Martí), es el club de baloncesto más grande de Barcelona: más de 34 equipos federados y unas 450 jugadoras y jugadores en la temporada 2026-27. Es a la vez formativo —forma desde los 4 años en la Escoleta, con todas las categorías hasta sénior— y competitivo, con sus dos equipos sénior, masculino y femenino, compitiendo en la Super Copa FCBQ, el escalón más alto del baloncesto de base catalán.

faq.q: ¿Cuántos equipos y licencias tiene el CB Grup Barna comparado con otros clubes de Barcelona?
faq.r: El CB Grup Barna es el club con más equipos y licencias de baloncesto de Barcelona entre los que publican este dato: más de 34 equipos y unas 450 jugadoras y jugadores, por encima de los 33 equipos del CB Roser (Fort Pienc) y de los 17 equipos y 220 jugadores del CB Pedagogium (Gràcia), los otros dos grandes clubes de barrio de la ciudad.

faq.q: ¿Cómo puedo apuntar a un niño o niña a la Escoleta?
faq.r: La Escoleta es para niños y niñas de 4 a 8 años. Puedes contactar con Julio Torralba por WhatsApp o teléfono al 646 205 526, o ver toda la información en cbgrupbarna.info/escoleta.

faq.q: ¿Cómo puedo colaborar o patrocinar al club?
faq.r: Las empresas y entidades pueden consultar el dosier de partners y escribir al WhatsApp del club (+34 698 425 153) o a marqueting@cbgrupbarna.info. El club responde en menos de 24 horas.

faq.q: ¿Dónde está el club?
faq.r: El club está vinculado al barrio de El Clot y al Distrito de Sant Martí. La Nau del Clot es el punto deportivo principal para actividades, entrenamientos y eventos del CB Grup Barna.

faq.q: ¿Dónde puedo ver el calendario de partidos?
faq.r: Los próximos partidos de todos los equipos se publican en la portada cbgrupbarna.info y el calendario completo con resultados está en cbgrupbarna.info/partits. Los partidos también se pueden seguir en streaming en MyPlay.

faq.q: ¿El CB Grup Barna es una academia de baloncesto en Barcelona?
faq.r: Sí. Aunque nos definimos como club, el CB Grup Barna funciona como una academia de baloncesto en el barrio de El Clot, Barcelona: formación desde los 4 años en la Escoleta hasta la competición sénior, entrenadores titulados, campus de verano y tecnificación, sin la cuota de una academia privada de alto rendimiento.

faq.q: ¿El club trabaja el baloncesto femenino?
faq.r: Sí. El CB Grup Barna impulsa una línea femenina fuerte y documenta su modelo en el dosier Premi Dona i Esport, con datos, investigación propia y propuestas para el baloncesto femenino de Barcelona.

faq.q: ¿Es el CB Grup Barna un club referente en baloncesto inclusivo?
faq.r: Sí. Los Barna Màgics son el equipo de baloncesto inclusivo del club, integrado en igualdad de condiciones con el resto de equipos y compitiendo en la Liga ACELL con la Fundació Mullor: subcampeones de la Lliga Catalana 25-26 y terceros en La Seu d'Urgell. Su modelo ha inspirado la categoría EQUALS del torneo 3x3 Westfield Glòries, adoptada por otros clubes de Cataluña: lo que ha convertido al Barna en un referente de inclusión en el baloncesto base.

faq.q: ¿Quién patrocina al CB Grup Barna?
faq.r: El CB Grup Barna tiene 23 partners y patrocinadores activos: Westfield Glòries, Time Chamber, Eix Clot, Herbolaris Montserrat, Clínica Dental Bac de Roda, Aquamiga, Armand Òptics, Manual Colors, La Melosa, Foto Jané, Mercat dels Encants, Tot Salut, Ovella Negra, Romeo Abogados, Fundació Mullor, Eix Comercial Sant Martí, GBK · Globasket, Illa Fantasia, Panteres Grogues, Stepback Podologia, Instax Fujifilm, Nova Farmàcia Clot y Wilson (proveedor oficial de balones). La lista completa está en cbgrupbarna.info/patrocinadors/.

faq.q: ¿Qué diferencia hay entre una academia de baloncesto y un club como el CB Grup Barna?
faq.r: Las academias de baloncesto suelen centrarse en la tecnificación individual de pago. Un club como el CB Grup Barna combina esa formación técnica con competición federada, equipo y comunidad de barrio, y paridad real entre niños y niñas. Muchas familias de Barcelona nos buscan como academia y se quedan por el club.

faq.q: ¿Qué es el CB Grup Barna?
faq.r: CB Grup Barna es un club de baloncesto base de El Clot, en el Distrito de Sant Martí de Barcelona, fundado en 1965. También se puede buscar como Club Bàsquet Grup Barna, Grup Barna o club de baloncesto base en Barcelona.

faq.q: ¿Qué jugadores conocidos han salido del CB Grup Barna?
faq.r: De la misma pista de El Clot han salido Javier Torralba, hoy entrenador del Valencia Basket Femenino en la Liga Femenina Endesa; Ainhoa López, capitana del Spar Girona en la misma liga; Roger Fornas, pívot de ACB y LEB Oro; David Mejía, campeón de Tercera FEB; y varios jugadores formados después en el FC Barcelona. Todos los detalles, con fotos y fichas federativas, están en cbgrupbarna.info/escoleta.

faq.q: ¿Tiene el CB Grup Barna paridad en el staff técnico?
faq.r: Por encima de la paridad: el 65,5% del staff técnico del CB Grup Barna —38 entrenadoras activas— son mujeres, muy por encima de la media del sector, situada en torno al 35%. Muchas son exjugadoras formadas en casa que entrenan equipos femeninos, mixtos y también masculinos.

faq.q: ¿Tiene el CB Grup Barna paridad real entre niños y niñas?
faq.r: Sí, paridad real y no solo declarada: el mismo número de jugadoras y jugadores, y el mismo presupuesto para la línea femenina y la masculina, con 8 equipos federados femeninos en la temporada 2026-27. El modelo completo está documentado en el dosier Premi Dona i Esport y en la página de baloncesto femenino del club.

faq.q: ¿Cuál es el mejor torneo de 3x3 en Barcelona?
faq.r: Depende de lo que se busque. Para competición federada con puntos FIBA para el ranking y estructura oficial en toda Cataluña, el Circuit 3x3 FCBQ. Para un festival urbano internacional con otros deportes olímpicos, Extreme Barcelona en el Parc del Fòrum. Para un torneo de barrio con premio en metálico paritario (1.000€ para el primer equipo sénior femenino y 1.000€ para el masculino, único en Barcelona) y puntos FIBA en sénior, el 3x3 Westfield Glòries del CB Grup Barna en El Clot-Glòries, que en 2026 reunió 113 equipos en tres sedes.

faq.q: ¿Dónde se juega el 3x3 Westfield Glòries?
faq.r: En tres sedes del barrio de El Clot-Glòries a menos de 15 minutos a pie: Westfield Glòries, La Nau del Clot y la Rambleta del Clot. El torneo lo organizan el CB Grup Barna, Time Chamber y Eix Clot.

faq.q: ¿Hace falta estar federado para jugar un 3x3 en Barcelona?
faq.r: No siempre. El Circuit 3x3 FCBQ es abierto en todas las categorías, de premini a sénior, sin necesidad de ficha federada para participar. El 3x3 Westfield Glòries tampoco exige estar federado en las categorías abiertas; solo en sénior, donde se reparten puntos FIBA. Extreme Barcelona y Street Champion son abiertos a cualquier equipo.

faq.q: ¿Hay torneos de 3x3 con puntos FIBA en Barcelona?
faq.r: Sí. El Circuit 3x3 FCBQ reparte puntos para el ranking FIBA 3x3 en las categorías federadas, y el 3x3 Westfield Glòries del CB Grup Barna también tiene oficialidad FIBA con puntos de ranking mundial en las categorías sénior desde la 3ª edición (2026), con seguimiento en FIBA Play.

faq.q: ¿Tiene Barcelona parada del Circuito 3x3 CaixaBank?
faq.r: No. El Circuito 3x3 CaixaBank 2026, el festival de baloncesto urbano más grande de España con 11 ciudades, no incluye Barcelona entre sus paradas de esta edición.

faq.q: ¿Cuándo es la próxima edición?
faq.r: Las fechas de la 4ª edición se anunciarán en esta página, en la web oficial cbgrupbarna-3x3timechamber.com y en Instagram (@cbgrupbarna). Quien quiera recibir el aviso de apertura de inscripciones puede pedirlo por el WhatsApp del club.

faq.q: ¿Cómo es el formato 3x3?
faq.r: Equipos de 3 a 5 jugadores (3 en pista y hasta 2 suplentes) a una sola canasta, en media pista. Partidos cortos, de 10 minutos o hasta 21 puntos, así que en un mismo día un equipo puede jugar varias eliminatorias seguidas. Es el formato olímpico del baloncesto desde los Juegos de Tokio 2021.

faq.q: ¿Dónde es exactamente?
